audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side all say 'Skill' (Pyke) while content win[0-6] all say 'Poppy' — the page renders two different answers to every row.
audit.why: Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) grounds Pyke's core E-dash engage on a toggle, her E wall-stuns, and her R can eject him off his reset chain; content's whys are kit-grounded and correct, full-layer sides are stale template rows.
audit.corrected: Flip all 7 phases[N].side to Poppy and rewrite each why to match the kit reasons already in content.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly key W-grounding at level 2, R-knockback denying the reset at 6, tanky itemization vs lethality at first item, and peel-fortress scaling late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the missingInteractions entry (Poppy R untargetable dodges Pyke's R commit) was not reflected anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Real cooldowns make the grounding threat concrete, and the untargetable-through-R interaction directly punishes an all-in cast into her ult.
audit.corrected: See breakdown.cooldowns and ahead edits below.
